spec.claim_summary: Long ETH/USDT on 4h when Senkou Span A is above Senkou Span B and a green candle closes above Span A, exiting when a red candle closes below Span A.
spec.untestable_reason: Requires Ichimoku Senkou Span A/B which is not a supported indicator, so no mechanical rule can be recovered.

claimed.other: would make more profit with this strategy than holding the coin

assumptions: NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Ichimoku Senkou Span A (green lead line) and Senkou Span B (red lead line) are not in the supported indicator set and cannot be encoded, and they are the heart of the entry/exit filter.
Direction assumed long because entry is bullish close above line and exit is bearish close below line.
Timeframe taken as 4h from chart timeframe.
